item.title: Reed
item.description: Credit: flatsound put out a song: we could live near the beach. I like it a lot. In the comments of that, @homunculeast wrote a poem. I read it a couple years back, and I wrote a poem then. I started writing again, so I cleaned up some stuff and decided to put it out here. Thank you to both flatsound and homunculeast. Maybe you would hurt me, Hurt me,
